variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished portrait game-screen concept for Blob Shop, 1024x1536 portrait, filling the frame, no phone bezel. The supplied image is the reference for the existing game and customer identity, NOT a layout to preserve.
Critical new layout: top 0–24% holds a compact logo and the same friendly brown-haired female customer in the upper-left and a compact rounded order card upper-right. The middle 25–72% is a broad uninterrupted work counter and oval work mat with ONE large coconut-cream soft blob centered at x50%, y49%; the blob has two individually attached googly eyes, one pink rabbit ear and one lilac horn, two tiny yellow duck toys and one yellow star visible inside. NO mouth, NO painted cheeks. Make the blob a physical rounded squishy mound viewed slightly from above, not a flat icon. It is the largest, dominant interactive object and can be freely kneaded from both sides.
MOVE ALL ingredient trays to the bottom area formerly blank yellow: bottom 76–94% has exactly TWO wide shallow trays side by side, each with a 2-by-2 set of four clear slots. Left tray holds exactly aqua capsule, cherry capsule, coconut capsule, and one separate eye. Right tray holds exactly pink ear, lilac horn, yellow duck, yellow star. No side trays, no vertical sidebars, no ingredients alongside the central blob. Small brass service bell at x50%, y71%, between main mat and bottom trays. Tiny help/sound controls stay unobtrusive. No large empty lower region.
Preserve the cute hybrid illustrative customer plus soft 3D toy-like props aesthetic from the reference. This is a believable implementable game UI mockup, not a promotional poster, no elaborate new decoration, no new mechanics, no coins or store menus. Keep same character identity and same basic props. All eight stock types must remain distinguishable. Strong tonal separation: the main mat is distinctly darker than all three blob materials (aqua, cherry pink and coconut cream). Coconut body must have clear sculpted silhouette, warm ivory midtones, soft contact shadow, and restrained specular highlights. Do NOT wash out colors or overexpose white surfaces. Keep toy colors intact, do not tint entire image monochromatically. Warm gentle lighting, legible dark UI text. All geometry, viewpoint and arrangement should follow these exact same proportions across this five-concept series.
Text: only 'blob shop' in the header, 'ЗАКАЗ 3 ИЗ 3', 'Необычного друга' on the order card, simple recipe icons with counts. On bottom ingredient slots short Russian names 'Аква', 'Вишня', 'Кокос', 'Глазик', 'Ушко', 'Рожок', 'Уточка', 'Звезда'. Avoid other explanatory captions or palette chips inside the game screen.

Color scheme for this particular image: Light lavender-plaster upper background #E8E3F2; warm ivory order card #FFF6E8; muted plum outer counter #7A668F; rich blueberry-purple oval mat #4A3A67; bottom trays pale lavender #CDBDDF with darker purple rims #806493; apricot small accents #EDA779. Pleasant daytime purple workshop, saturated enough for clear contrast, not a dark night scene.
